_comment: Where this client's briefing lives in Notion (agency rule, 3 Nov 2026). Fill in at kickoff. clientInput: the Client Input database inside the client's Pros Buddy Client Portal (copy its schema from an existing portal: Question, Status To ask/Asked/Answered/Used, Kind Kickoff/Monthly, Month, Answer, Files, For, Answered by, Answered on). tasks: the agency Tasks database; project is the client's option in its Project column, so the task shows under the client on the board. pm: the project manager who talks to the client. contact: how the client wants to be contacted (email, phone, text), from the portal notes.
